01 · The list

Home and everyday objects,
level by level

The house and what is in it, in Chinese: rooms, furniture, household objects and everyday possessions, from the HSK vocabulary lists with readings and meanings.

In Lock&Learn Chinese these words sit in their level packs (HSK 1, HSK 2), one per glance on the widget: a word waits in hanzi with its pinyin; one tap reveals the meaning and a real sentence. HSK 1 is free; every other pack opens with a free preview and another word unlocks daily.

Type to filter by hanzi, pinyin or meaning. Flashcards hides the meaning until you tap a row; Shuffle deals the list in a new order.

8 words
House and Home in Chinese: 8 words from the HSK lists, HSK 1 to HSK 2
HanziPinyinMeaningLevelExample
杯子bēizicup or glassHSK 1桌子上有一个杯子。Zhuōzi shàng yǒu yī gè bēizi.There is a cup on the table.
电脑diànnǎocomputerHSK 1我没有电脑。Wǒ méiyǒu diànnǎo.I do not have a computer.
电视diànshìtelevision; TVHSK 1我不看电视。Wǒ bù kàn diànshì.I do not watch television.
椅子yǐzichairHSK 1椅子在桌子后面。Yǐzi zài zhuōzi hòumiàn.The chair is behind the table.
桌子zhuōzitable, deskHSK 1书在桌子上。Shū zài zhuōzi shàng.书在桌子上。
房间fángjiānroomHSK 2
门méndoor or gateHSK 2
手机shǒujīcell phoneHSK 2

03 · Questions

Asked and
answered

What are common household words in Chinese?

The table lists the 8 home and household words on the HSK vocabulary lists, each with its reading and English meaning.

Which HSK levels are these words from?

5 from HSK 1, 3 from HSK 2. The level chip on each row says where the word sits, so you can stop at your level or read ahead. Beginner-level words carry a real example sentence; the rest show word, pinyin and meaning, with their sentences in the app.

How do I learn home and everyday objects words on my iPhone Lock Screen?

Install Lock&Learn Chinese, then touch and hold your Lock Screen, tap Customize, tap the widget area and choose Lock&Learn Chinese. Enable the level packs these words come from (HSK 1, HSK 2). A word waits in hanzi with its pinyin; one tap reveals the meaning and a real sentence.

Is Lock&Learn Chinese free?

Yes. The app is free on iOS: HSK 1 is free, every other pack opens with a free preview, and another word unlocks daily. Lock&Learn+ is an optional upgrade that opens every pack at once, offered as a yearly plan or a one-time lifetime purchase.
